How ChessLens works

ChessLens uses Stockfish 17 Lite in your browser for analysis and the WintrChess classification model for Theory, Best, Excellent, Okay, Inaccuracy, Mistake, and Blunder. The Game Review uses the same local engine pipeline.

What is PGN?
The standard plain-text move-list format most chess sites export.
What is FEN?
A one-line snapshot of a single board position.
Why isn't the opening flagged as inaccurate anymore?
Opening positions are matched against the WintrChess opening database, so recognized theory is classified as Theory instead of being scored as an engine mistake.
Is my data stored?
No — everything runs and stays in your browser tab.
ChessLens — a free, in-browser chess analysis board.No accounts. No data leaves your browser.
